entries.title: Rain days redone: one row per series, wet in rain blue over dry in grey, an arrow from his typical dry race to his typical wet one

values.label: rows (default): each series its own ruled row, wet races in a light rain lane over dry races, arrow dry → wet; worse ← → better written across the top
bands: the dry races become his usual range (the middle half, a grey band) with the wet races falling onto it; dry races as a quiet rug beneath
round 2: all 167 dots in every series colour, All races / By series toggle

entries.look: Career → More from the archive → Rain days. Watch the races fall into their rows, then the arrows draw: All 167 races points right (82% wet vs 63% dry), Formula Ford and GB3 point left. Point at any dot: it is ringed, a guide runs up to the scale, and the card shows the track still, the finish and the weather with how sure it is (series report, observed, modelled). Solid, ringed and soft dots are those three tiers.

entries.title: The explorer's dots redone: same motion, dots as small beads on an even lattice, every row on one rhythm, better → on the scale

values.label: beads (default): each dot lit from the top left in its series colour, paper rim, soft shadow; columns one dot wide
flat: the same even lattice with flat, quieter dots
round 2: the free beeswarm with flat full-colour dots

entries.look: Career → More from the archive → The explorer. Watch the pile split into series, then flip Series / Season / Track / Weather: the dots travel as before. The dots now stack in even columns and rows share one rhythm. Point at any dot for its race card; flip ?ddxdots=flat and ?ddxdots=old to compare.
